permissions.readDesc: Can see organization-wide figures: consumption, rotation, forecasts and costs

settings.enableAnalyticsDescription: Show the analytics tab (rotation, spend forecasts, purchase patterns). Disable for small home inventories where there is not enough history for these to be meaningful.
settings.showInventoryValueDescription: Show stock values across the app: on the stats overview, the product screens, and in exports and printouts. It is a business metric — disable for home inventories that keep no purchase prices for it to add up.
